##### Project general facts

Coastline Beach Residences, situated on the pristine Sobha Siniya Island, is a masterpiece of coastal luxury and refined living. The development offers an impressive variety of residences, including 1- and 2-bedroom apartments and 2- and 3-bedroom duplexes, designed to cater to diverse lifestyles. Every unit promises breathtaking views of the sparkling beach or the lush, expansive golf course, blending natural beauty with architectural elegance. These thoughtfully designed homes are the epitome of seaside serenity, perfect for those seeking an unmatched blend of relaxation and sophistication.

Coastline Beach Residences boast exceptional amenities, offering an unparalleled blend of luxury and relaxation. Residents can indulge in a vast range of offerings, including a vibrant marina, a world-class golf course, and a beautifully landscaped park. Adventure awaits with water sports, a lagoon for serene moments, and a yacht club, while the clubhouse and boutique retail arcade provide spaces for socializing and entertainment. Families will also enjoy the dedicated kids' play zones and health enthusiasts can benefit from the fitness club, making this community ideal for all.

Set against the stunning backdrop of white sands and turquoise waters, the Coastline Beach Residences redefine island living. Beyond the residences, a retail boulevard, scenic bicycle tracks, and exclusive air taxi and helicopter landing pads elevate convenience and accessibility. Each detail is meticulously curated to deliver a harmonious balance of tranquility and vibrancy, offering not just a home but a lifetime of memories. Coastline Beach Residences is truly a haven for those who cherish the finer things in life.

##### Location description and benefits

Siniyah Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is a serene and picturesque destination renowned for its natural beauty and tranquil environment. This island offers a pristine escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, characterized by its lush landscapes, sparkling waters, and abundant wildlife. Its unspoiled beaches and gentle coastal breezes make it a perfect retreat for those seeking relaxation and a connection with nature.

The island's strategic location provides easy access to major urban centers while maintaining a sense of seclusion. With its proximity to Dubai and Sharjah, Siniyah Island combines the benefits of a peaceful, secluded environment with the convenience of urban amenities. This makes it an ideal spot for both residents and visitors who wish to enjoy a balance of tranquility and accessibility.

Siniyah Island is also known for its commitment to sustainable development and environmental preservation. The island features eco-friendly infrastructure and carefully planned urban spaces that respect the natural landscape. This dedication to sustainability ensures that Siniyah Island remains a beautiful and welcoming destination for years to come.
